$comment: Sections of the 31 document templates, for the template engine (TEMPLATE_ENGINE.md). Extracted from design/prototypes/CDWorkspace.html (TEMPLATE_SCHEMAS); figma frame IDs from templates.manifest.json. A field or table column is a label (plain text) or { label, kind } for a real control: choice (options), role (production roles), people (`single`; `fills` columns from a picked Nia user's role), number, date (`after`: a date it can't be before), dateTimeRange, duration (`units`), yesNo (note placeholder), check, phone, email, money, time, timeRange (`options`: the two labels), weather (`options`: conditions), pages (script eighths), refs (`source`: a table whose rows are ticked by number); a choice can take `optionsFrom` another section's answers. Fields sections can use `layout: "cards"`. A letter's `fills` map its [placeholders] to the fields that fill them.
